subject: SummitBridge pilot — executive windows and sponsor intro
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jill Turner <jill.turner@summitbridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SummitBridge pilot — executive windows and sponsor intro

Hi Jill —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. SummitBridge looks like a great fit for our pilot (and the use-case you described aligns well with the autoscaling + cost controls we showed). To get the exec sponsor and technical stakeholders onboard, can we lock a 45-minute demo + sponsor intro next week? Goal: 30-minute demo of the pilot flow with 15 minutes for feedback / next steps and a clear action owner for procurement.

Proposed quick windows (PDT):
- Tue Apr 3, 11:00–11:45
- Wed Apr 4, 09:30–10:15
- Thu Apr 5, 15:00–15:45

I've attached a short agenda and one-pager for sponsors. If none of these work, please suggest two adjacent 45-minute windows that include your CIO or VP of Engineering (even if the CIO can join the last 15). Karthik will own the demo run and Marissa will cover onboarding/ops items.

Attachments: summitbridge_exec_agenda_v2.pdf; sponsor_onepager.pdf

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0162

From: Jill Turner <jill.turner@summitbridge.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit.rao@summitbridge.com>, procurement@summitbridge.com
Date: Sun, 1 Apr 2028 12:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SummitBridge pilot — executive windows and sponsor intro

Logan —

Thanks for the note and the materials. The agenda is helpful. Quick update on attendees: our VP Product (Amit Rao) is available and would like to see the end-to-end flow; our CIO is traveling but can block 15 minutes at the end of the meeting on Apr 4 if that helps. Procurement looped in to begin SOW/PO discussions after the demo.

Our preferred times are Apr 4, 09:30–10:15 or Apr 5, 15:00–15:45. If one of those works for you, please send a calendar invite. Also — can you include a short slide on data handling and the private deployment option? Our security team will want that summary.

Thanks,
Jill Turner
Head of Strategic Accounts, SummitBridge
jill.turner@summitbridge.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jill Turner <jill.turner@summitbridge.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Apr 2028 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SummitBridge pilot — executive windows and sponsor intro

Great — thanks Jill. Apr 4 09:30–10:15 PDT works on our side and we can reserve a 45-minute slot. I'll send the invite from my calendar (45 mins) with the dial-in and a short pre-read link.

Per your ask, we'll include a 5-slide security/data handling appendix and call out the private deployment option and KMS integration. Marissa — can you drop the brief ops checklist (what we'll need from SummitBridge pre-demo) into the Drive link before the invite goes out?

Also including a stub ICS: redwood-demo-link.ics (attached).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jill Turner <jill.turner@summitbridge.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SummitBridge pilot — executive windows and sponsor intro

Jill / team —

I've uploaded a 1-page ops checklist to the MAP (link below) with the minimal items that let us run a meaningful pilot: service account for limited test traffic, an example prompt set, and a sample data retention policy. If SummitBridge prefers a private deployment for the pilot we'll include steps for KMS key exchange in that doc.

Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1AaBC-mupSummitBridge-MAP

If your CIO can only join the last 15 minutes on Apr 4, that is fine — we'll structure the session to show the end-to-end flow first and surface strategic/ROI items at the end for the CIO. Also, if your VP Product prefers an alternate time on Apr 4 later in the day, we can offer a 30-minute late slot as a backup.

Attachments referenced: sponsor_onepager.pdf (for sponsor-level talking points).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jill Turner <jill.turner@summitbridge.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@summitbridge.com
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 16:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Apr 4 09:30–10:15 PDT — SummitBridge pilot demo (exec + sponsor)

Hello all —

Thanks for the quick coordination. We are confirmed for Apr 4, 09:30–10:15 PDT. Calendar invite sent (45 min). Agenda: 30-min demo, 10-min business/ROI discussion, 5–10 min CIO Q&A.

What we'll bring: demo run (Karthik), onboarding/ops checklist (Marissa), security appendix (Stephanie) — see attached one-pager.

Pre-reads: summitbridge_exec_agenda_v2.pdf, sponsor_onepager.pdf
MAP link: https://app.redwoodinference.com/mutual-action-plan/SB-2028-042

If procurement needs a Draft SOW or licensing outline before the demo, let us know and we'll provide a starter SOW within 48 hours.

See you on Apr 4 —
Logan Wright
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
